summary.headline: LG Electronics India Q2 FY27 revenue rose 19.5% YoY to INR73.8bn, with EBITDA margin up 63bps to 9.5%.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 was the second consecutive quarter of double-digit growth and the strongest growth quarter since the listing a year ago. Revenue reached INR73.8bn (+19.5% YoY), EBITDA rose 28% to INR7.01bn with margin up 63bps to 9.5%, and PAT grew 25.7% to INR4.89bn. H1 revenue was INR146.13bn (+17.5%), EBITDA INR16.16bn (+27.9%) and PAT INR11.42bn (+26.5%). Management announced entry into Vehicle Solutions (automotive infotainment and telematics) to be made at the Sri City plant, while FY27 guidance of mid-teens revenue growth and early double-digit EBITDA margin was reiterated.

segments.name: Home Appliance and Air Solution
segments.commentary: Revenue INR47.72bn (+20.9% YoY), the highest quarterly growth since listing; segment EBIT INR4.16bn (+28.4%), margin 8.7% vs 8.2%. Washing machines, refrigerators and room ACs all grew double digits; dishwashers had a breakout quarter.

segments.name: Home Entertainment
segments.commentary: Revenue INR26.08bn (+17.2% YoY) on a high base, third straight double-digit quarter; segment EBIT INR3.37bn (+19.9%), margin 12.9% vs 12.6%. Mix shift to larger screens and Mini LED added to margin; offline value market share at an all-time high.

segments.name: B2B Information Display
segments.commentary: Management says it is now a second profit engine alongside TV with steadier margins; commercial TV is the strongest sub-segment. B2B is about 10-11% of total revenue; target is 15%+ within three years.

guidance_outlook: FY27 guidance unchanged: mid-teens revenue growth and early double-digit EBITDA margin; management aims to beat this guidance and industry.
Compressor commercial production at Sri City to begin in Q3 FY27; air conditioner manufacturing to follow in Q4 (around January 2027); both lines fully operational by end FY27.
Sri City adds 2 million units of capacity; total investment of INR50bn over the next few years, expected to double existing production capacity.
Management expects the next two quarters (H2 FY27) to be better than H1 for RAC, with Q4 typically about 55% of annual RAC sales.
Export ambition: significant YoY export growth expected in FY27; export markets expanded from 50 to 68 countries.
Management targets B2B growth of 20%+ over the long run and 15%+ share of revenue within three years.
capex_capacity: Q2 FY27 capex INR8.7bn vs INR2.3bn in Q2 FY26, driven by the Sri City, Andhra Pradesh third plant.
Sri City third plant: compressor production in Q3 FY27, AC production in Q4 (around January 2027); total committed investment INR50bn over the next few years.
Sri City to supply both domestic and export markets and act as a multi-category hub; Vehicle Solutions (telematics first) to be manufactured there.
Localisation of compressors expected to cut costs and forex and supply-chain risk, as part of compressors are currently sourced from outside LG.
demand_pricing: Management says all categories grew double digits in Q2; washing machines had their highest growth in eight quarters, with fully automatic now above 60% of WM sales.
Premium multi-door refrigerators (side-by-side and French door) grew more than 50%; single-door refrigerators grew double digits.
TV: QNED drove 55-inch-and-above, now over half of TV revenue; the 32-inch mass segment also picked up.

Price action: two rounds of selective price increases taken this year across categories; management says no major demand slowdown has followed. Channel inventory described as lean ahead of festive season.
Working capital increased by INR6.56bn to build channel stock ahead of festive and wedding season; cited go-to-market investments in Q2.
Exports: 151 distribution partners (from 112); Essential Series sold in 21 countries.

qa_highlights.question: How is demand trending across AC, refrigerators, washing machines and TV into H2, and is RAC seasonality changing?
qa_highlights.answer: Sanjay Chitkara said demand is encouraging; Q2 RAC sales were above Q1 despite off-season, driven by heat, and H2 is expected to be better than H1. Festive demand is strong across TV and WM.

qa_highlights.question: Why enter Vehicle Solutions, and what does LG bring?
qa_highlights.answer: Dongmyung Seo said VS is a strategic B2B diversification step, leveraging LG's global telematics and infotainment leadership, with local manufacturing at Sri City and a phased rollout starting with telematics. No financial targets were given.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the EBITDA margin expansion, and is it sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Management gave no margin guidance. It cited premiumisation, a richer channel mix, higher-margin B2B, exports and AMC services, plus scale and operating efficiencies.

qa_highlights.question: Sri City timelines and expected cost benefits?
qa_highlights.answer: Atul Khanna said compressors start commercial production in Q3 FY27 and AC lines in Q4 (around January 2027), with both fully operational by end FY27. Localised compressors (2 million units capacity) are expected to cut costs permanently and reduce forex and supply risk.

qa_highlights.question: Vision for the company over three years?
qa_highlights.answer: Soonjoo Seo cited three pillars: exports, premiumisation in the domestic market, and new B2B lines like Vehicle Solutions, with a stated aim of a fundamentally stronger company by FY30.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the price increase is cost-driven, and is there demand risk?
qa_highlights.answer: Gurpinderjeet Singh said raw materials (steel, aluminium, copper, resin) and FX drove the increases, which were selective, with two rounds taken this year. He reported no major demand slowdown after the hikes.

qa_highlights.question: What is Q2 export contribution and FY27 export outlook; geopolitical impact?
qa_highlights.answer: Jung Won Byun did not give a Q2 export figure or a numeric FY27 export target. He said exports are expected to grow significantly YoY and that geographic diversification limits dependence on any one market.

qa_highlights.question: B2B sub-segment performance, and data-centre orders?
qa_highlights.answer: Aditya Bhasin said B2B is about 10-11% of revenue, with commercial TV and large commercial system AC projects leading and government projects growing. On data centres, the company has chiller and cooling capability but gave no order details.

risks_watch: Input cost pressure from copper, aluminium, steel, resin and memory chips, plus FX; further price increases possible if costs persist.
Demand response to two rounds of price increases in the festive quarter.
Sri City compressor (Q3 FY27) and AC (Q4 FY27) commissioning timelines; ramp-up and cost benefits not yet visible.
Vehicle Solutions is a new business with no financial targets or capex disclosed yet.
Geopolitical uncertainty affecting exports; no Q2 export figure disclosed.
Q2 working capital build of INR6.56bn and cash decline from INR57.07bn to INR50.51bn; channel inventory normalisation after festive season.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on demand, growth and the Sri City timeline, with repeated festive-season optimism. Management was evasive on specifics: it declined to give margin guidance, gave no Q2 export figure, and gave no data-centre or VS financial details.
key_quotes: Today, I am very proud to announce that we are entering the Vehicle Solutions business in India.

We remain firmly on track to commence compressor manufacturing at the facility in the third quarter of this fiscal year, a milestone that will strengthen our cost competitiveness, deepen our localization levels, and support the next phase of our growth, both domestically and in global markets.
While we don't provide specific margin guidance, we remain confident in the long-term profitability of the business.

adds.what: Sri City third plant: 2 million units capacity (compressors first, then AC manufacturing)

growth.why: FY27 guidance of mid-teens revenue growth and early double-digit EBITDA margin was held, backed by the Sri City third plant (2 million units, INR50bn committed, compressors from Q3 FY27 and AC from Q4 around January 2027), double-digit growth across all categories and export expansion, though no order book or contract figures were given.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: EBITDA margin rose 63bps YoY to 9.5% in Q2 FY27 on premiumisation, B2B and exports, but management gave no margin guidance and FY27 guide is only 'early double-digit' (H1 EBITDA margin about 11.1%, so H2 implied lower).

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Sri City third plant is under construction with compressor commercial production in Q3 FY27 and AC manufacturing around January 2027 (Q4), adding 2 million units under an INR50bn committed investment.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Revenue grew 19.5% YoY in Q2 and all categories grew double digits, with H2 RAC expected above H1 and FY27 guided at mid-teens revenue growth (H1 +17.5%).

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Q2 capex of INR8.7bn was about 3.8x Q2 FY26 and the INR50bn Sri City programme is only partly deployed, with the company describing it as expected to double existing production capacity, so further capex announcements are plausible though not explicitly guided.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Guidance of mid-teens revenue growth was held after H1 growth of 17.5%, and management said it aims to beat guidance and the industry, but no upgrade was given.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Input costs (copper, aluminium, steel, resin, memory chips) and FX are rising, and two rounds of price hikes plus a INR6.56bn working-capital build ahead of festive season could hurt demand or margins if channel stock does not sell through.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Vehicle Solutions (telematics first) is to be manufactured at Sri City with a phased rollout, and AC manufacturing starts around January 2027; no financial targets were disclosed.

rows.label: Export growth and market expansion (50 to 68 countries)
rows.why: Management expects significant YoY export growth in FY27, export markets rose from 50 to 68 countries and distribution partners from 112 to 151, though no Q2 export figure was disclosed.

rows.label: B2B scale-up to 15%+ of revenue
rows.why: B2B is about 10-11% of revenue today, with a target of 15%+ within three years and 20%+ long-run growth, led by commercial TV and large commercial AC projects.

rows.label: Compressor localisation at Sri City
rows.why: Localised compressor capacity of 2 million units (commercial production Q3 FY27) should cut costs and forex and supply-chain risk, but cost benefits are not yet visible and no savings figure was given.

tone.note: Management was confident on festive demand, the Sri City timeline and double-digit growth, but evasive on margin guidance, Q2 export figures, and Vehicle Solutions and data-centre financials; analysts pressed on margin sustainability, price-hike demand risk and export outlook.
